payload.subject: Re: Parent & Baby Swim — Fall registration open
payload.body:
hi — thanks for the note. we'd like to hold a spot for the fall parent & baby swim on saturdays at 9:30. could you let us know what you need from us to confirm the registration and when payment is due?

thanks!

parsed.rationale: Email says reply to hold a spot, but no memory/calendar context confirms the family's availability or child details, so I kept the reply minimal and asked about next steps.
